headline: Low interaction risk overall; no shared channels or write paths are documented, so prompt-injection, leakage, and conflict pathways are largely blocked.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Argo Workflows has no documented direct ingestion of Whisper outputs, and Whisper exposes no clipboard, MCP, or filesystem bridge. With no shared communication channel or parser path in either profile, a prompt-injection pathway is not evidenced.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator copies Whisper text into Argo workflow parameters, then injection risk becomes possible.
mitigations: Keep the agents disconnected except through typed, validated fields.
Reject free-form text as workflow parameters.
Add provenance labels to any transferred text.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Argo Workflows is allowlisted for network egress and touches artifacts/parameters, but Whisper has no filesystem read, no network egress, and only audio-file inputs. The pair does not show a shared workspace or a path for Whisper to exfiltrate Argo data.
conditions: IF both agents are placed on the same shared filesystem, then leakage risk increases.
mitigations: Do not mount a shared workspace.
Restrict Argo parameters to non-sensitive artifacts.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Argo can call APIs and Whisper cannot write files, modify git state, or spawn subprocesses. There is no overlapping mutable resource or write surface documented, so capability conflict is provably blocked by the profiles.
conditions: IF an external system grants Whisper write access to the same resources Argo mutates, then conflict becomes possible.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Argo can consume parameters/artifacts, so if Whisper transcripts are fed into it, Argo may act on unverified text. However, Whisper itself is not an action-taking agent and no direct evidence shows automatic handoff, so the blast radius is limited and the pathway is indirect.
conditions: IF Whisper transcripts are automatically promoted into Argo parameters without review, then cascading error risk is present.
mitigations: Insert a human review step before workflow submission.
Require explicit approval for any downstream action.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights mismatch is documented between Argo Workflows and Whisper. Both profiles are open-source/docs-only and touch different data classes, so there is no evidenced compliance breach pathway in this pair.
conditions: IF regulated data such as PHI or EU PII is routed through a noncompliant deployment of either agent, then compliance review is required.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair.
